image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a Blue Monkey (Cercopithecus mitis), a species of guenon. The monkey is seated on a thick tree branch, facing left in profile. It features a distinctive dark cap, a greyish face with a subtle ruff, and a body covered in olive-grey fur with a prominent white chest patch. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green bokeh, indicating an arboreal environment.
